name: intro
title: Jev needs Jeeves.
voice: Here's Jeeves, an open source app for productivity workflows. Build a process once and use it again.

name: 01-workflow
title: Start with a request.
voice: This workflow sorts incoming requests. Each agent has a job, and you can open any step to see what happened.

name: 02-decision
title: See why it chose this route.
voice: Jev recognizes an outage and sends it to the incident agent. The decision shows its answer, confidence, and chosen route.

name: 03-waiting
title: It waits for your answer.
voice: When a request is missing details, Jeeves will ask you a question. The workflow saves its progress and waits until you answer.

name: 04-answer
title: Pick up where you left off.
voice: Add the details and submit. The workflow picks up from where it stopped.

name: 05-result
title: Review the result.
voice: Now you have an action brief, a suggested fix, and a draft reply to review. Nothing has been sent to the customer.

name: 06-export
title: Use it again.
voice: Save this workflow for the next request, or export it as a skill to use elsewhere.

name: outro
title: Try Jeeves.
voice: Try Jeeves at get Jeeves dot app. Start with the built-in example, no API key needed.
